items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 31:1
items.html: It is known that the whole NRNHY of ZA is not, compared to the Nekudim, anything but the phase of Nefesh in the vessel of Keter, lacking the nine lower Sefirot of the vessels and the nine Sefirot of the lights — namely, only a single Kav out of the ten Kabin of the Nekudim, as above in Answer 33. Thus ZA in pregnancy, who has nothing but the phase of Nefesh of these NRNHY, meaning a tenth part of the Kav that was corrected in Atzilut, is now one hundredth of what he had at the Nekudim. He is therefore called at that time, in the fetus, by the discernment of Challah [dough offering], which is one hundredth. And likewise Adam HaRishon is called the Challah of the world, for the same reason: for the whole wholeness that was corrected in him was of the discernment of a single Kav of Atzilut, and after the sin nothing remained in him but Nefesh of Nefesh, in the vessel of the Keter of the Keter, which is one hundredth, as stated above, page 683, Item 93, and in the Inner Light there, see there. (Item 24).
